title: Bird leaves for Earl Hines and buys Ramey a coat
summary: Bird left McShann in fall 1942, joined Hines, and bought Ramey a second-hand coat.

bands.name: Andy Kirk and His Clouds of Joy

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution

blocks.x: But it was in the fall of -- of '42 when -- when Bird finally left the band permanently. That's when he went

with Earl Hines. When he was supposed to go with Earl Hines. He auditioned with Earl Hines, but Earl wasn't ready to take him right then, you know. So he was -- we left him in Detroit, and he -- he got to New York with Andy Kirk, and very few days, a little while later, he got with Earl Hines.

And he stayed with Earl Hines through January, I know, because I left McShann band in '43 in February, and Earl Hines had played the Apollo Theater, and I went by to see Bird, and he had bought me a coat, a bearskin coat, because I was wearing a chinchilla, a raglan, let me tell you everyday, a real raglan. All over it was raggedy.
He bought me a second hand coat, and he had told me, he said, now, I get some money, the first thing I'm going to do is buy you a coat.
